description: Get email flow (automation) performance for a Klaviyo account. Returns metrics for welcome series, abandoned cart, post-purchase, etc.

conversion_metric_id.description: Metric ID for revenue tracking (Placed Order). REQUIRED. Get from list_metrics tool first.

end.description: Custom range end, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

quarter.description: Quarter 1-4 (with year) - convenience for a full quarter.

start.description: Custom range start, YYYY-MM-DD. Overrides timeframe. Data floor: 2023-06-01 (earlier is clamped).

timeframe.description: Preset period. Default: last_30_days. Ignored if a custom range is given.

name: flow_report
